purpose: convert the RAD end-to-end design into an executable technical pilot without opening biological inference or production sequencing

candidate_protocols.rationale: plant ddRAD literature reports broad tag recovery across diverse angiosperm genome sizes; included as a high-complexity candidate
classic ddRAD candidate with broad plant use and an intermediate expected tag density
widely used rare/common-cutter plant candidate; retained because methylation sensitivity and reduced complexity may improve some Cirsium strata

stage_A_screen.sequencing_rule: shallow sequence all 24 libraries together with balanced indexing; compare protocols only after equal-read downsampling
hard_failures: failed or grossly abnormal library in any mandatory anchor system
persistent adapter-dimer or off-window fragment dominance after standard cleanup
severe read-retention failure not explained by a documented technical incident
protocol-specific loss of either Cirsium brevicaule or Cirsium irumtiense anchor
ranking_metrics: usable loci per anchor after equal-read downsampling
dispersion of usable locus count among the eight anchors
anchor-system shared-locus counts at 6-of-8, 7-of-8 and 8-of-8 concept occupancy
depth evenness and high-depth repeat/paralog tail
stage_A_screen.advancement_rule: advance the best two nonfailed protocols by technical Pareto ranking; if no two protocols are technically viable, redesign enzyme/size-window candidates before Stage B rather than lowering biological QC gates

stage_B_reproducibility.repeat_balance: one preregistered technical repeat per anchor system; four repeats assigned to TOP1 and four to TOP2, prepared in an independent library batch from the original
stage_B_reproducibility.batch_design: each protocol is represented in at least two independent library-preparation batches; anchor identity, ploidy/genome-size class and focal status are interleaved rather than confounded with batch

technical_concordance_gate.comparison_rule: calculate after the frozen pilot genotype/depth filters and only on callable overlapping loci; report pairwise values rather than only a pooled mean

single_protocol_gate: all eight anchor systems yield analyzable libraries
every preregistered technical repeat meets genotype concordance >=0.95 or has a documented rebuildable technical failure
every preregistered technical repeat meets core-locus recovery >=0.90 or has a documented rebuildable technical failure
equal-depth usable-locus recovery does not show a protocol-specific failure of the large-genome, small-genome or high-ploidy anchor class
6-of-8/7-of-8/8-of-8 anchor shared-locus curves are sufficient to justify attempting the all-Japan strict shared-locus sensitivity
stage_B_reproducibility.decision_rule: if exactly one protocol passes all single-protocol gates, freeze it for the corresponding production stratum; if both pass, choose by shared-locus recovery plus lower anchor dispersion without using trait outcomes; if neither passes across all anchors but one or both work within coherent strata, stratify production protocols and cancel a single all-Japan SNP matrix

pilot_depth_saturation.plateau_rule: a production read target may be frozen only when the pilot provides a visible locus-recovery plateau; operationally, the chosen target should lie at or above the first depth where additional sequencing yields less than 10 percent additional usable loci for the relevant analysis stratum and technical concordance has already passed
pilot_depth_saturation.no_plateau_rule: if the pilot never approaches a plateau, top up the pilot or redesign complexity before committing the full biological panel

stacks_pilot_rule.within_population_parameter_optimization: use r80-style optimization within focal or population-like subsets; do not treat r80 across deeply divergent Japan38 concepts as the same estimand
stacks_pilot_rule.n_grid_rule: for the chosen M, evaluate n = M-1, M, M+1 where nonnegative
stacks_pilot_rule.cross_concept_gate: for the all-Japan sensitivity, summarize homologous catalog-locus recovery by anchor-concept occupancy (6/8, 7/8, 8/8) rather than selecting Stacks parameters to maximize a tree topology
stacks_pilot_rule.freeze_rule: freeze primary parameters and filters before any P01-P05 trait-history result is inspected

production_opening_conditions: Stage A completed and two protocols advanced or a documented redesign completed
technical-concordance gate passed for the chosen production protocol or protocol stratum
enzyme pair and size window frozen
production read target frozen from saturation analysis
primary Stacks parameters and analysis-specific occupancy matrices frozen
ploidy handling defined for every production concept or unresolved cytotypes explicitly excluded from dosage-dependent analyses
